pages.text: The Standard Tank holds 16,000 mB and the Pressurized Tank holds 32,000 mB. A bucket is 1,000 mB. Open the menu to transfer with fluid containers and set individual faces for a pipe or machine.

pages.title: Fill an Item
pages.text: For a tank filling recipe, put one Glass Bottle in a tank holding at least 250 mB of XP Juice. Take one Bottle o’ Enchanting from the output. A Stick and 1,000 mB of Nutrient Distillation make one Nutritious Stick.

pages.title: Empty an Item
pages.text: For an emptying recipe, insert a Wet Sponge with room for 1,000 mB of water. The tank takes the water and returns a dry Sponge. Clear the result slot before processing another.
Chain a tank after the $(l:enderio:machines/vat)VAT$(/l) to buffer its liquid. Once the connection is in place, make a small batch and check that the tank accepts exactly that liquid.
